paite: Huan huai a kipan apawt a, a-omna kholam atungta a; anungzuite'n azui uhi.
heading: Nazaret Jesu Deihlouhna / (Mat 13.53-58; Luk 4.16-30)

paite: Sabbath ni ahong hi a, sinagog ah thu ahilh a; mi tampi athu zate'n, "Hiai mi'n hiai thu koi a kipan amuh ahia? Hiai mi kiang a pilna piak bang pilna ahia? Akhut in hichi tel a thillamdang ahih bangchidan ahia?" ana chi uhi.

"Hiai mi Mari tapa, Jakob, Joses, Judas leh Simon sanggampa, singlem bawlpa ahi kei a hia? Asanggamnute leng hiai a i kiang ua om ahi kei ua hia?" achi ua, lamdang asa mahmah uhi. Huchi in atung ah alungkim kei uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Zawlnei zaw ama kholam ah, ama inkote lak ah, ama inn kia lou ngal ah pahtawi louh in a-om ngei kei," achi hi.
Huan mi damlou tawmchikte tung a khut koih a ahihdam kia lou ngal huai ah thil thupi lua ahih kei hi.
Agintak louh uh lamdang asa mahmah hi. Huan thuhilh kawm in khuate atawn vialvial hi.
Huan sawm-le-nihte asam a, nihnih in asawlkhia a; dawi ninte tung a thuneihna leng apia hi.
heading: Sawltak Sawm-le-nihte Sawlkhiakna / (Mat 10.5-15; Luk 9.1-6)

paite: Azinna ua ding in chiangkhun kia lou ngal bangmah, tanghou leh kawlzal leng, akawnggak ua dangka tawi louh ding achi bikbek hi.
Khedap bel but ding achi a; puanak nih silhthuah kei un, achi lai hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Koipeuh ah leng na tunna inn uah, huai a kipan na pawt mateng uh tung kinken un.
Huan koi khua peuh in ahon kipahpih louh ua, na thu uh angaihkhiak kei ualeh huai a kipan na pawt chiang un, amau mohpaih ding in, na khepek nuai ua leivui kai na tatkhe ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in apaikhia ua, mite akisik ding uh ahi chih agen uhi.
Dawi tampi leng adelhkhia ua, damlou tampi leng thau anilh ua, ahihdam uhi.
Huan kumpipa Herod in ana za a, amin athan ziak in, "Baptispa Johan, misi lak a pan thounawn a, huaiziak a huai thilhihtheihnate'n amah a sem ahi," achi hi.
heading: Baptispa Johan Sihna / (Mat 14.1-12; Luk 9.7-9)

paite: Midangte'n bel, "Elijah ahi, achi ua; midangte'n, ma lai zawlneite bang zawlnei khat ahi," achi uhi.
Himahleh Herod in ana zak in, "Alutang ka tanpa ngei, hong thounawnta ahi," achi hi.
Herod in a-unau Philip zi Herodias ziak in mi asawlkhia a, Johan amansak a, suangkul ah hen in ana khum khinta a; Herodias zi in ana neita ngal a.
Johan in lah Herod kiang a, "Na unaupa zi na neihsak siang lou ahi," ana chih khit tak ziak in.
Huaiziak in Herodias in amah amudah a, hihlup a-ut a, himahleh ahihthei kei hi.
Herod in, Johan midiktat leh misiangthou ahi chih atheih ziak in amah akihta a, amah a-enkhia a, athu azak in, thil tampi ahih a, kipaktak in angaikhia hi.
Huan Herod in apian ni in amithupite, sepaih heutu liante, Galili gam a miliante a ding a zan ankuang alui lai in hun lemtang ahong omta hi.
Herodias tanu ahong lut a, alam a, Herod leh a-ankuang umpihte akipaksakta hi. Kumpipa'n numei naupang kiang ah, "Na deihdeih hon ngen in, ka hon pe ding,” achi hi.
"Bangpeuh na hon nget phot, hon pe ding ka hi, ka gam kimkhat nangawn leng," chi in akiang ah akichiam hial hi.
Amah apawt a, anu kiang ah, "Bang ka ngen dia?" ava chi hi. Anu'n, "Baptispa Johan lutang," ana chi hi.
Huan amah kintak in kumpipa kiang ah ava lut pah a, "Kuangpi a Baptispa Johan lutang na hon piak pah ka ut," chi in angen hi.
Huan kumpipa alungkham mahmah a; himahleh akichiamna leh a-ankuang umpihte ziak in asel nuam kei hi.
Huan kumpipa'n amah vengte lak a sepaih khat alutang va la ding a thu pia in asawl pah hi. Amah suangkul a pai in alutang ava tankheta hi.
Huai lutang kuang in ahon tawi a, numei naupang kiang ah apia a, huan numei naupang in anu kiang ah apeta hi.
Huan anungzuite'n azak un, aluang la in, han ah avuita uhi.
Huan sawltakte Jesu kiang ah ahong kikhawm ua, thil bangkim, athilhih peuh uleh athuhilh peuh uh, ahong hilh uhi.
heading: Sawltakte Kikna Leh Mipi Sangnga Vakna / (Mat 14.13-21; Luk 9.10-17; Joh 6.1-14)

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Noumau kia in gamdai mun ah atuam in hong unla, khawl tadih un," achi hi. Mipi atam a, akuan leh apai akiphamat ua, an nangawn leng ane man kei uhi.
Huchi in gamdai mun ah long in apaituamta uhi.
Mite'n apai lai uh amu ua, mi tampi in amau athei ua, kho chih a pan huai ah khe in ataikhawm ua, ana makhelhta uhi.
Huchi in amah hong paikhiak in mipi tampitak amuta a, chingtu ding nei lou belamte bang ahih ziak un alainat mahmah a, thu tampi ahilhta hi.
Huan ni akai mahmahta a, anungzuite akiang ah ahong ua, "Hiai gamdai mun ahi a, ni akaita mahmah hi.
I kim a loute leh khuate a hoh a, anek ding uh banghiam bek aleitheihna ding un amaute paisakta in," achi uhi.
Ama'n bel akiang uah, "Noumau nek ding pia un," chi in adawng hi. Amau akiang ah, "Makhai zanih man tanghou va lei in nek ding pe ding ka ding uam?" achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Tanghou phel bangzah na nei ua? Hon en dih ua," achi a. Huan aneih zah uh atheihtak un, "Nga leh ngasa nih," achi uhi.
Huan ama'n, avek un loupa hing tung ah apawlpawl a tusak ding in akiang uah thu apia hi.
Huchi in apawlpawl in, zakhat khawng, sawmnga khawng in atu uhi.

Huan ama'n tanghou phel nga leh ngasa nih ala a, van lam en in avualzawl a, tanghou phelte abalkham a, ama ua lui ding in anungzuite kiang ah apia a; ngasa nih leng huaite tengteng lak ah ahawmzak hi.
Avek un ane ua, akham chiat uh.
Huan tanghou leh ngasa nente bawm sawm-le-nih adim hi.
Tanghou phel nete pasal piching ngen sangnga ahi uh.
Huan mipi akikhensak nung in gal khat lam a Bethsaida a na pai masa ding in long ah anungzuite atuangsak pah hi.
heading: Tui Tung Ah Khe In Jesu Apai / (Mat 14.22-33; Joh 6.15-21)

paite: Amau akikhensak nung in thum ding in tang ah ahohtou hi.
Nitaklam ahong hih in, tuipi laitak ah long a-om a, amah kia in gam ah a-om hi.
Long kalh a mangbang in amaute amu a, huih in ahilou lam ah asep hi. Huchi in zanven lina ding kuan in tuipi tung a khe a pai in amau lam ahon zuan a, amau paisuak san atum hi.
Himahleh amah tuipi tung a khe a pai amuh un sikha sa in, akikoukhia uhi.
Avek un amah amu ua, alau mahmah uhi. Himahleh ama'n amau ahoupih pah a, akiang uah, "Khamuangtak in om un, keimah ka hi, lau kei un," achi hi.
Huan long ah akiang uah atuangtou sam a, huih adai maimah hi. Huan lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Alungtang uh akhauh ziak in tanghou beu thillamdang thu angaihtuah ban kei uhi.
Huan gal khat lam akai un Gennesaret gam atung ua, luipiau ah long akhih uhi.
heading: Gennesaret A Hihdamna / (Mat 14.34-36)

paite: Long a kipan apawt nung un mite'n amah ana thei pah uhi.
Huai gam kim tengteng ah atai ua, a-om chih azakna peuh uah alupna un damloute ahon zawng hial uhi.
Huan khoneu leh kholian ah khopi leh khota leh koipeuh ah leng alutna ah damloute, dawr mun ah alumsak ua, apuan mong bek khoihsak ding in angen ngutngut uhi. Huan amah khoih peuhmah adam uhi.
